test_clipped_grad_basic: test the gradient_clipping.clipped_grad function to compute sum of per-example clipped gradients with basic parameters
test_clipped_grad_rescale: test the gradient_clipping.clipped_grad function with rescale_to_unit_norm enabled and optional microbatch_size
test_clipped_grad_with_aux: test the gradient_clipping.clipped_grad function with has_aux=True to return auxiliary data alongside clipped gradients
test_clipped_grad_pytree_params: test the gradient_clipping.clipped_grad function with pytree params and multiple batch_argnums for logistic regression loss
test_clipped_grad_prng_key: test the gradient_clipping.clipped_grad function with a prng_argnum for stochastic functions using JAX random keys
